actions.description: Invokes a dialog to invite, request, challenge or share, in a chat or timeline.

image.name: Image
image.desc: A Sprite object to take an image from for the share.

text.name: Text
text.desc: A message to include with the share.

data.name: Data
data.desc: A string of data to attach, available as EntryPointData if launched from the share. Max 1000 chars.

switch-context.name: Switch context
switch-context.desc: Whether to switch the user into the new context created on sharing.

actions.display-text: Post custom update with template ID [i]{0}[/i], CTA [i]{1}[/i], image {2}, text [i]{3}[/i], data [i]{4}[/i], strategy [i]{5}[/i], notification [i]{6}[/i]
actions.description: Post a custom update in to a message thread.

template-id.name: Template ID
template-id.desc: ID of the template this custom update is using, as defined in fbapp-config.json.

cta.name: CTA
cta.desc: Optional "call to action" (CTA) button text. Leave empty to use the default ("Play").

image.name: Image
image.desc: A Sprite object to take an image from for the update.

text.name: Text
text.desc: A message to include with the update.

data.name: Data
data.desc: A string of data to attach, available as EntryPointData if launched from the update. Max 1000 chars.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.desc: How to deliver the update. 'Immediate' posts immediately (optionally clearing any other pending updates); 'Last' posts when the game session ends.

notification.name: Notification
notification.desc: Whether to send a push notification for the custom update. Only use push notifications for updates that are essential and immediately actionable.

actions.description: (Android only) Request to create a home screen shortcut.
Prompt the user to subscribe to a bot associated with the game.
Request that the client switch to a different Instant Game.

app-id.name: App ID
app-id.desc: The Application ID of the Instant Game to switch to. It must belong to the same business as the current game.

data.name: Data
data.desc: A string of data to attach, available as EntryPointData if launched from the switch. Max 1000 chars.

actions.display-text: Change context with filter [i]{0}[/i], min size [i]{1}[/i], max size [i]{2}[/i]
actions.description: Opens a dialog allowing the player to switch to a different context.

filter.name: Filter
filter.desc: How to filter the suggested contexts.

min-size.name: Min size
min-size.desc: The minimum number of participants that a suggested context should ideally have. Use -1 to specify no limit.

max-size.name: Max size
max-size.desc: The maximum number of participants that a suggested context should ideally have. Use -1 to specify no limit.
